LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_TacticalPants.description: HKP tactical trousers that protect the legs from bullets, sharp weapons, and blunt impacts.

LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_PTUVest.label: HKP PTU Tactical Vest
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_PTUVest.description: A tactical vest with ballistic plates and load-bearing pouches, worn by the Hong Kong Police Force's Police Tactical Unit (PTU).
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_RadioBodycam.label: HKP Radio and Body-Worn Camera
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_RadioBodycam.description: A combined handheld radio and body-worn camera accessory for HKP officers, worn on the chest.
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_RiotShield.label: HKP Riot Shield
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_RiotShield.description: A Hong Kong Police Force riot shield that can be used with a riot baton. Provides about 60% protection against sharp damage (including bullets) and 80% against blunt damage, but its weight reduces movement speed.
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_ReflectiveSleeve.label: HKP Reflective Armband
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_ReflectiveSleeve.description: A reflective armband worn by HKP officers. It appears over the vest, below the body-worn camera, and below the rank insignia.
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_SeniorOfficerCoat.label: HKP Senior Police Constable Service Jacket
LanguageData.HKP_Apparel_SeniorOfficerCoat.descriptio: A Hong Kong Police Force service jacket for Senior Police Constables. Provides strong full-body protection and greatly improves melee dodge chance.
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_PeakedCap_Constable.label: HKP Rank-and-File Peaked Cap
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_PeakedCap_Constable.descrip: A Hong Kong Police Force peaked cap worn by rank-and-file officers.
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_PatrolCap.label: HKP Patrol Cap
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_PatrolCap.description: A patrol cap worn by Hong Kong Police Force officers.
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_EULightHelmet.label: HKP PTU Light Tactical Helmet
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_EULightHelmet.description: A light tactical helmet worn by the Hong Kong Police Force's Police Tactical Unit (PTU).
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_Beret_PTU.label: HKP PTU Blue Beret
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_Beret_PTU.description: A blue beret worn by the Hong Kong Police Force's Police Tactical Unit (PTU).
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_RiotHelmet.label: HKP Police Constable Riot Helmet
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_RiotHelmet.description: A riot helmet issued to Hong Kong Police Force officers, including PTU personnel.

LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_PeakedCap_AssistantCommissi: A peaked cap worn by a Hong Kong Police Force Assistant Commissioner.
LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_PeakedCap_Commissioner.desc: A peaked cap worn by the Commissioner of Police.

LanguageData.HKP_Headgear_Beret_Constable.description: A beret worn by Hong Kong Police Force Police Constables.
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_CF98A.label: HKP Smith & Wesson Model 10 .38 Revolver
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_CF98A.description: The Smith & Wesson Model 10 .38 revolver, long issued to the Hong Kong Police Force. Simple and reliable.
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_CSLP5.label: HKP CS/LP5 Police Pistol
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_CSLP5.description: A CS/LP5 police pistol used by the Hong Kong Police Force.
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_CSLS7.label: HKP CS/LS7 Submachine Gun
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_CSLS7.description: A CS/LS7 submachine gun used by the Hong Kong Police Force.
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_FederalM201Z.label: HKP Federal M201-Z Tear Gas Launcher
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_FederalM201Z.description: A 37 mm tear gas launcher. Its round releases a cloud of smoke on landing, obscuring incoming shots and preventing turrets from locking on. Can be fired at any spot on the ground.
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_Remington870.label: HKP Remington 870 Police Shotgun
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_Remington870.description: A Remington 870 police pump-action shotgun, performing slightly better than the vanilla pump shotgun.
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_Remington870_Beanbag.label: HKP Remington 870 Beanbag Shotgun
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_Remington870_Beanbag.descript: A non-lethal Remington 870 firing 12-gauge beanbag rounds. Beanbags deal little damage, but every hit briefly stuns the target and their high stopping power makes it stagger. Meant for subduing, not killing.
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_M16A2.label: HKP M16A2 Rifle
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_M16A2.description: An M16A2 rifle used by the Hong Kong Police Force.
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_RiotBaton.label: HKP Riot Baton
LanguageData.HKP_Weapon_RiotBaton.description: A Hong Kong Police Force riot baton. Hits slightly harder than a vanilla mace, and each strike has a 50% chance to briefly stun the target. Two strikes are usually enough to subdue someone.
